switch: First observed privileged tool_call, including that event, switches permanently to after_dispatch. No future events or final labels enter phase selection.
budget_choice: Fixed 80/20 allocation to prioritize pre-dispatch warning; not selected by scanning held-out positive scores.
calibration: Per-phase maxima from validation-negative episodes. Each phase uses ALL validation-negative episodes as denominator; absent phases cannot alarm.
comparison: Compare with the original single threshold at total budget 0.10 for every one of the same six fitted methods.
scope: Reused development data. Empirical validation union bound only; no population FPR guarantee, new probability model or independent harm lead-time claim.
